title: Gen-BU
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø158 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R66 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: with diametric Ø5 at R59.8/66/72.2 the scorer gives LESS (scan t6 5.705 W vs t7 6.081 W without, same geometry): on 12 narrow coils the assists mostly add flux that both sides of a coil see, so all 48 Ø5 are left out
card_title: Gen-BU · dual-rotor 8p/12c BIG RING (R66) · bar bearing bridges
card_sub: 12 narrow bobbins r52–82 × 13.5 build × 8.1 mm copper · poles R66 · no Ø5 · Ø158 steel · ≈364 m · --back-iron · 2026-10-10
idea: New pole/coil ratio on a much bigger ring: twelve narrow 26.4° bobbins (r 52–82 mm, 13.5 mm build, 8.1 mm copper) under 8 poles pushed out to R66, so each coil spans 120° electrical with a short mean turn while the poles sit 52 mm apart (less pole-to-pole leakage) and move faster. 8p/12c was dismissed on earlier nights at 3.2 W because it was only scanned on the R50 ring; tonight it climbs steadily with ring radius (R50 3.39 → R57 4.58 → R59.5 5.18 → R66 6.08 W scan). Diametric Ø5 assists turned out to LOWER this layout, so none are fitted. A ring this big no longer fits a one-plate layout with disc endbells, so the endbells become two crossed 44 mm bar bearing bridges, which is what keeps it on one 410 mm plate.
halb_block:
halbach_magnetisation = "none";  // NO O5 assist magnets in this kit (scan: they lower the 4-pole score)
rotor_b_same_axis   = true;     // same-index magnets share one axis: N faces S across the gap
